description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Summon Monster class feature or spell

Benefit: The summoner summons an additional monster from his summon monster class feature or from spell. This talent stacks with Superior Summoning if the spell is being used to summon 1d3 or 1d4+1 number of lower monsters. When using this talent on a spell, increase the MP cost by 1/2 of the spell level, this does not increase the spell level (For example, Summoner 3 can use this with Summon Monster II). When used with the summon monster class feature, spend an additional use of the ability.

system.requirements: Summon Monster class feature or spell
